set.body: Run an independent audit before treating the multivariate layer as usable. Verify module-relations placement, shared/JVM/JS boundaries, sparse densification policy, algebra laws, multiblock restrictions, solver capability boundaries, and fixture parity against mvproj/multivarious where behavior is intended to match. Acceptance: sbt compileAll and sbt testAll pass; warning-clean build; docs/module-relations.md and module README are updated; no Spark/Breeze/JVM-only dependency leaks into shared multivar; final evidence is recorded on this issue.
set.title: Multivar release gate: architecture audit and parity evidence
